title: 5-day vs 20-day moving-average crossover on NZD/USD (Pukthuanthong-Le, Levich, Thomas)
source: Pukthuanthong-Le, Levich & Thomas (2006), Do Foreign Exchange Markets Still Trend?, NYU Stern working paper FIN-06-030 (draft 13 Nov 2006)
why: The paper's exotic-currency group (Exhibit 3-4) is the only place it finds profit after 2000, and the New Zealand dollar is the one member we trade. Same 5/20 average rule as the majors spec, on NZD/USD alone, with the paper's 2000-2006 figures (NZD information ratio 0.74 over 2000-2006; calendar-year mean profits of 18.9% in 2000, -15.3% in 2001, 29.1% in 2002, 23.3% in 2003, 0.1% in 2004, -12.7% in 2005 and 8.5% in 2006, from Exhibit 3). Kept to one symbol so the test does not add trials for the other exotics, which we do not trade.
